description:
Diagnostic that makes the [[fz-f98.5]] class loud at the source. Detect when a TYPE IS SILENTLY WIDENED TO any and warn:
- a function PARAMETER whose type graduates to any (no declared type narrowed it), vs a parameter DECLARED :: any (intentional -> no warning).
- a STRUCT FIELD that DEFAULTS to any (no declared field type), vs a field DECLARED any (intentional -> no warning).
The discriminator is PROVENANCE: 'graduated/defaulted any' (silent widening) warns; 'declared any' is silent. Requires tracking whether an any came from an explicit declaration or from defaulting/widening. Uses crate::diag::{Diagnostic, codes}; warnings are errors per CLAUDE.md if we control them. Tests observe the diagnostic (telemetry/diagnostic capture). This warning would have caught the Range-fields-are-any bug immediately and pinpoints the graduation sites for the sibling fix. Depends on shared provenance plumbing with the honor-declared-types fix.

comments.text:
GROUNDED + CRITICAL SEQUENCING CONSTRAINT.

Machinery is ready: world.emit_warning_once(Diagnostic::warning(code, msg, span)) (dedup via WarningDiagnosticKey, flushed in drive.rs); add a codes::TYPE_PARAM_GRADUATED_TO_ANY / TYPE_STRUCT_FIELD_DEFAULTED_TO_ANY. Two emission sites: (param) where activation/contract typing leaves a param any with no declared narrowing; (struct field) struct schema vs declared @type t (struct_assertion_ty / typedef derivation) -- a field absent from @type defaults to any. Provenance discriminator: declared :: any => silent; graduated/defaulted any => warn.

BLOCKING CONSTRAINT (measured): graduated-any is PERVASIVE. Even the trivial Enum.to_list(1..3) has 22/110 param positions at any across 6 functions (reduce_cont, reduce_step, the reduce lambdas). Across the whole prelude it is everywhere -- it IS the f98.5/f98.6 over-monomorphization surfacing as any. Since CLAUDE.md makes warnings ERRORS, turning this warning on fatally would fail the build/matrix immediately and broadly.

=> f98.9 cannot land as a fatal warning until the graduated-any it detects is cleaned up (f98.5/f98.6 convergence). Sequencing options for the human: (a) land f98.9 as a NON-FATAL lint first (informational; surfaces the cleanup surface without breaking the build), then flip to fatal after f98.5/.6; (b) gate f98.9 behind f98.5/.6 completion. Recommend (a): the non-fatal warning becomes the telemetry/signal that DRIVES f98.5/.6 and proves convergence when it goes quiet. f98.9 should depend on that decision; not implemented pending it (would break the build today).

BLAST RADIUS MEASURED (precise rule: a CONCRETE declared param type, no vars/not any, with actual input any). lib 89 failed (13 baseline => +76); matrix 57 (32 baseline => +25). ~101 newly-failing tests. Distinct graduation sites cluster into THREE (filed): f98.10 Enumerable protocol-boundary erasure (t(a)->any; reduce/3, reverse/1, to_list/1; ~104 hits; the ROOT), f98.11 arithmetic operands graduate before +/*/-/%/concat (~600 hits, DOWNSTREAM of the roots), f98.12 pid->any at send (~9 hits).

KEY: the ~101 is dominated by ONE root (f98.10 protocol erasure) flooding arithmetic everywhere. Disabling 101 mostly-working-feature tests loses disproportionate coverage for a transitional warning. Recommendation: BURN DOWN THE ROOT FIRST -- fix f98.10 (the protocol analog of f98.8's struct-field recovery) which collapses most of the 101, then land f98.9 fatal with only the small residual disabled (markers -> remaining cluster tickets). f98.9 stays the acceptance test: it goes quiet as f98.10/11/12 land, then flips permanently fatal. Detection rule validated (concrete-declared param graduated to any); struct-field-defaulted-to-any is the analogous second emission site (undeclared struct, fz-f98.8-adjacent).

title: Warn when a parameter or struct field type is graduated/defaulted to any (not declared any)
